events.title: Techno Underground - Berlin Edition
events.description: World-class techno night at Berlin's most iconic venue. International DJs spinning dark, industrial techno. Strictly 21+. No photos policy.

events.title: House Music Marathon
events.description: 12-hour house music journey featuring deep house, tech house, and progressive sets. Multiple rooms with different vibes.

events.title: Trance Euphoria Festival
events.description: Epic trance event with legendary DJs. Uplifting melodies and massive drops. State-of-the-art sound system and visuals.

events.title: Drum & Bass Jungle Night
events.description: High-energy drum & bass night with jungle vibes. Fast breaks, heavy bass, and non-stop dancing. Local and international selectors.

events.title: Dubstep Bass Shaker
events.description: Bass-heavy dubstep night with massive sound system. Featuring riddim, brostep, and classic dubstep. Floor will be shaking.

events.title: Progressive Psytrance Journey
events.description: Mind-bending psytrance experience. Progressive grooves building to full-power psytrance. UV lights and psychedelic visuals.

events.title: Electro & Breaks Revival
events.description: Old-school electro and breakbeat party. Vintage vibes with modern production. For true electronic music heads.

events.title: Future Bass & Melodic Dubstep
events.description: Emotional journey through future bass and melodic dubstep. Beautiful melodies meet heavy drops. All ages welcome.

events.title: Hardstyle Supremacy
events.description: Massive hardstyle event with top-tier producers. Raw kicks, euphoric melodies, and intense energy. Hardstyle family unite!

events.title: Minimal Techno Deep Session
events.description: Stripped-back minimal techno for purists. Hypnotic grooves and subtle progressions. Intimate underground atmosphere.

events.title: Garage & UK Bass Night
events.description: UK garage throwback with modern bass. 2-step, grime, and bassline. Celebrating British underground culture.

events.title: Industrial & EBM Dark Night
events.description: Dark industrial and EBM night. Harsh beats, distorted synths, and gothic atmosphere. For the darker side of electronic music.
